trap.label: phrasal verbs put
trap.wrong: We put off the meeting for next week.
trap.right: We put the meeting off until next week.
trap.why: Com objeto substantivo, a partícula pode ir depois; o brasileiro costuma usar “colocar” literal. Put off = adiar; put forward = propor.

mcq.q: Put your case ___ at the board.
Os diretores ___ the vote until May. (adiar)

fix.wrong: We put off it until May.
fix.right: We put it off until May.

fix.wrong: She put forward of a plan.
They put the tent in last night.
fix.right: They put the tent up last night.

rewrite.prompt: Use put off: “We postponed the vote.”
Use put forward: “She proposed a plan.”
Com pronome: “We put off the vote.” (it)
